question: To whom is the concluding obeisance of this section directed?
premises: Obeisance is offered to Raghunātha the lord
Obeisance is offered to the husband of Sītā
inference: The obeisance is directed to Raghunātha, the lord and husband of Sītā.
plain_english: Obeisance to Raghunātha, the lord, the husband of Sītā.
